name: sugarshock
description: a showcase repository for Twine SugarCube 2

scripts.watch: yarn build-packages && (yarn workspaces foreach --all --parallel --interlaced --include "packages/*" run watch & tweego --format=sugarcube-2 --output index.html --head=src/head-content.html --watch node_modules/@spectreforge/sugarcube-hotkey/dist src/twee)
scripts.typecheck: yarn build-packages && yarn workspaces foreach --all --include "packages/*" run typecheck
scripts.gen-asset-index: b3sum index.html > assets/offline-index.txt && fd -tf -I -g -E 'offline-index.txt' '*' assets -X b3sum >> assets/offline-index.txt
